7 doubles/twins + 2 Family Suites. Exclusive use available for groups of 16+ guests (or by paying the full 16-guest rate for smaller groups).
30% Commission rate (Full Board) confirmed arithmetically as Rack x 0.70 (e.g. Adult Green: 451 = 644 x 0.7 exactly).
No verified STO/commission rate exists for the Game Package product (its STO file is unreadable) - only Rack is on file for Game Package.

maasaiMaraReserveFee.raw: Adult Jan-Jun: $100/24hrs; Adult Jul-Dec: $200/24hrs; Child under 18 Jan-Dec: $50/day

mandatoryFees.note: Non-refundable, non-transferable, mandatory, subject to change. Payable directly with KAPS or included in booking; Community Levy paid directly to Nigel Archer Safaris.

childPolicy.raw: Sharing with at least 1 adult: 8-12yrs 35% off adult rate; under 8yrs (upon request) 50% off adult rate.

singleSupplementPolicy.raw: 3 or less single tents per booking: single room rate. 4 or more single tents: double room rate applies instead.

tripleOccupancy.raw: Additional camp bed added to double occupancy tent, subject to availability, children under 12 only.

activitiesAndExtras.item: Guided bush walk outside reserve (Full Board doc only)
Hot Air Balloon Ride with Champagne Breakfast
Exclusive use of vehicle per day
Mara Airstrip drop off/pick up besides Ol Kiombo

activitiesAndExtras.amount: 25% nightly rate per person plus extra lunch

policies.deposit: 20% non-refundable deposit on booking, provisional hold 14 days if arrival >3 months away
policies.balancePayment: Full payment due 45 days prior to arrival
policies.cancellation: 80% fee 44-31 days prior; 100% fee within 30 days prior
